origin.description: The https origin of the page that shows the widget (a local origin while testing).

ticket.description: Give it to the admin widget (data-ticket).

browserToken.description: The website's browser token: visitor routes, from https://<exact domain> or a local origin.

serverToken.description: The website's server token: the merchant's server only, never with an Origin header. It also reaches every visitor route, acting for the visitor named by SS-Visitor-IP (and SS-Sign-In).

ticket.description: A ticket from POST /v1/tickets: admin widgets, only from the origin it names.

SSVisitorIp.name: SS-Visitor-IP
SSVisitorIp.description: With the server token: the visitor's IP address (required on writes, else 400 visitor_ip_required). These calls count in their own window of 3,000 requests per minute per route per website, plus the per-visitor limits.

SSActorId.name: SS-Actor-Id
SSActorId.description: With the server token: the member of your staff the call acts for (1–64 of A–Z a–z 0–9 _ . : @ -).

SSActorName.name: SS-Actor-Name
SSActorName.description: The acting member's name, percent-encoded UTF-8, at most 120 characters (with SS-Actor-Id).

SSActorRole.name: SS-Actor-Role

action.description: What was done, for example payment.refunded.

target.description: The id of what it was done to.

type.description: bundle: these products together for a price or a percent off; buy_x_get_y: buy some, get some off.

items.description: bundle: the products of a set ([] for buy_x_get_y).

price.description: bundle: what a set costs, minor units (never more than its value); null: value percent off instead.

buy.description: buy_x_get_y: units of scope bought (0 for bundle).

get.description: buy_x_get_y: units of getScope discounted (0 for bundle).

scope.description: buy_x_get_y: what is bought (empty for bundle).

getScope.description: buy_x_get_y: what is discounted (empty for bundle).

value.description: The percent off: of a set without a price (0 with a price), or of each discounted unit (100 = free).

startsAt.description: From when it applies (inclusive); null: from now on.

endsAt.description: Until when it applies (exclusive); null: no end.

limit.description: Most uses in all (orders placed with it); null: no limit.

used.description: Uses so far: counted when an order is placed with it, given back when that order is cancelled. Never written by these routes.

BundleChanges.description: The bundle’s members to change (each optional).

items.description: bundle (required): each product once with its quantity. Errors at /items/<n>/…; unknown products at /scope/productIds.

price.description: bundle: what a set costs, minor units; null or left out: value percent off.

value.description: The percent off, above 0 and at most 100: bundle without a price (required then); buy_x_get_y: off each discounted unit (default 100 = free).

get.description: buy_x_get_y (required).
